row.name: Canadian National Railway Company Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=33 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.86 tightness=1.02 base_volume_vs_leg=0.86 base_volume_vs_avg=0.99
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 33 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.86 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -1.2% vs its 20-SMA, -3.7% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: Three independent measured failures — C (base 33 sessions, giveback 0.86, tightness 1.02), RE (burst bar only 56% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume below prior session and only 60% of the 50-session average, with the extended-base catalyst requirement unmet) — combine with a visually declining base that has drifted steadily lower from ~130 to ~115 over the shaded region, making this a downtrend with a small bounce rather than an orderly consolidation. The signal bar itself is modest and the base gave back 86% of the prior leg gain.
claude.key_risk: The base is a multi-month declining channel, not a tight consolidation, and the burst bar shows no range or volume expansion to suggest a genuine momentum shift.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 117.78 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
